dialogue.origin: 相談ありがとうございます。宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.content: Thank you for reaching out. I look forward to assisting you.

dialogue.origin: お願いします。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Likewise, I look forward to it.

dialogue.origin: はじめに年齢、性別、今日の相談したいことよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: To start, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you’d like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 16歳　女性誰とも話せなくていつも一人で居ます。学校行きたくないです
dialogue.content: I'm 16, female. I can't talk to anyone and I'm always alone. I don't want to go to school.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that.

dialogue.origin: お悩みについて、もう少し詳しくお聴きしてもいいですか❔
dialogue.content: Could I hear a bit more about your concerns?

dialogue.origin: グループに入れなくて、孤立してます。学校行きたくないです
dialogue.content: I can't seem to fit into any groups, so I'm isolated. I don't want to go to school.

dialogue.origin: 孤立してるんですね。それは、いつごろからですか？差し支えなければお話下さいね
dialogue.content: I see you're feeling isolated. If you don't mind sharing, when did this start?

dialogue.origin: 入学してからずっとです。心を許して話せる人もいません。
dialogue.content: It's been this way ever since I started at this school. There's no one I can really open up to and talk with.

dialogue.origin: それは、お辛いですね
dialogue.content: That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.origin: はい　死にたいです
dialogue.content: Yes... I want to die.

dialogue.origin: 死にたいほどの、お気持ちなんですね。
dialogue.content: So you're feeling so distressed that you want to die.

dialogue.origin: はい。どうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.content: Yes. What should I do?

dialogue.origin: おうちでは家族とは、相談したり、話し出来る人はいますか❔
dialogue.content: At home, is there anyone in your family you can consult with or talk to?

dialogue.origin: 親は忙しいし、誰にも話せません
dialogue.content: My parents are busy, and I can't talk to anyone.

dialogue.origin: 周りに誰も話せないのなら、お辛いですね
dialogue.content: It must be very hard when there’s no one around you to talk to.

dialogue.origin: はい。もうどうしたらいいかわかりません
dialogue.content: Yes. I just don’t know what to do anymore.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: こんな時に少しでも話せる人がいたらいいですが
dialogue.content: It would be nice if you had someone you could talk to, even just a little, at a time like this.

dialogue.origin: お名前はなんと、およびすればいいでしょうか❔
dialogue.content: What would you like me to call you?

dialogue.origin: A子でいいです
dialogue.content: A-ko is fine.

dialogue.origin: Aと呼んでください
dialogue.content: Please call me A.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。Aさん
dialogue.content: Thank you, A.

dialogue.origin: 学校には行きたい気持ちはありますか❔
dialogue.content: Do you have any desire to go to school?

dialogue.origin: 行きたくはないですけど、行かないのも困りますよね
dialogue.content: I don't want to go, but not going would also be a problem, wouldn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。行きたい気持ちもあるんですね
dialogue.content: I see. So there’s also a part of you that wants to go.

dialogue.origin: ないこともないです
dialogue.content: It's not that I don't.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 学校の先生と話すことはありますか❔
dialogue.content: Do you ever talk with your teachers at school?

dialogue.origin: ありません
dialogue.content: No.

dialogue.origin: ないんですね
dialogue.content: I see, you don’t.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Right.

dialogue.origin: 今日の相談したいことは学校にいく気持は少しあるけど話す人もいないから通える何かしらきっかけがほしい感じでしょうか
dialogue.content: From what you've said, it sounds like you have some desire to go to school, but since you don't have anyone to talk to, you're looking for some kind of starting point to make it possible to attend. Is that right?

dialogue.origin: 怖くて学校に行けないです
dialogue.content: I’m too scared to go to school.

dialogue.origin: 怖いと学校も行けなくなってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: When you’re scared, it can make it hard to go to school.

dialogue.origin: はい　どうしたらいいかわかりません
dialogue.content: Yes. I don't know what to do.

dialogue.origin: 学校以外だとSNSやオンライン、ネットでの友達はいますか❔
dialogue.content: Outside of school, do you have any friends on social media or online?

dialogue.origin: 友達というか…はい。
dialogue.content: Friends... well, yes.

dialogue.origin: 外で少しでも繋がりがあればいいですね。
dialogue.content: It's good that you have some connection, even if it's outside of school.

dialogue.origin: はい・・・
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: ネット友達とは、どんなことを話すことが多いですか？
dialogue.content: What kinds of things do you usually talk about with your online friends?

dialogue.origin: アニメの話とかです
dialogue.content: Things like anime.

dialogue.origin: アニメお好きなんですね。例えばどんなアニメですか？
dialogue.content: So you like anime. What kind of anime, for example?

dialogue.origin: 最初は鬼滅”で盛り上がっていました
dialogue.content: At first, we were all really excited about 'Demon Slayer'.

dialogue.origin: いいですね。鬼滅。映画でも流行りましたね。
dialogue.content: That's great. 'Demon Slayer.' The movie was a big hit, wasn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい。その時はいっぱい話せて楽しかったです
dialogue.content: Yes. Back then, I was able to talk a lot and it was fun.

dialogue.origin: それは、とてもよかったですよね。
dialogue.content: That must have been really good for you.

dialogue.origin: イラスト書いてあげてたら、いっぱい(いいね！ももらってうれしかったです
dialogue.content: I drew illustrations for them, and I was happy to get a lot of 'likes'!

dialogue.origin: ネットのお友達とは学校の、お話はする事ありますか❔
dialogue.content: Do you ever talk about school with your online friends?

dialogue.origin: 凄いですね
dialogue.content: That's amazing!

dialogue.origin: 学校での話はしません
dialogue.content: We don’t talk about school.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。失礼いたしました
dialogue.content: I see. I apologize for asking.

dialogue.origin: でも、楽しかったです
dialogue.content: But it was fun.

dialogue.origin: 私も鬼滅映画はみたので感動しましたよ
dialogue.content: I saw the 'Demon Slayer' movie too, and I was very moved.

dialogue.origin: 楽しめて充実してるならいいですね。
dialogue.content: It's great that you were able to enjoy it and feel fulfilled.

dialogue.origin: 流行ってたし、盛り上がって楽しかったです
dialogue.content: It was popular, and it was exciting and fun.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。今もファンは多いと思うので。
dialogue.content: That's right. I'm sure it still has many fans.

dialogue.origin: 今日の相談したいことで話せてないことはありませんか❔
dialogue.content: Is there anything else you wanted to talk about today that we haven't covered?

dialogue.origin: 楽しかったんですけど、
dialogue.content: It was fun, but...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes?

dialogue.origin: そのうちアンチコメされるようになって・・・
dialogue.content: Eventually, I started getting hate comments...

dialogue.origin: アンチコメントですか？
dialogue.content: Hate comments?

dialogue.origin: はい・・・怖いです
dialogue.content: Yes... It's scary.

dialogue.origin: それは、誰からですか？怖いですよね。特にネットは怖いので、どうしていいかわからなくなりますよね
dialogue.content: Who are they from? That must be scary. The internet can be an especially frightening place, so it's understandable that you wouldn't know what to do.

dialogue.origin: しつこく言われて、本当に怖いです
dialogue.content: They're relentless, and it's really scary.

dialogue.origin: あんまりしつこいので、クラスの誰かなのかとも思ったりして
dialogue.content: They're so persistent that I've started to wonder if it might be someone from my class.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。誰からとかはわからない感じですか❔しつこいと本当に怖いですよね
dialogue.content: I see. So you don't know who it is? When it's that persistent, it's truly terrifying.

dialogue.origin: 怖くなってしまって、もう
dialogue.content: It's gotten so scary that I just...

dialogue.origin: もしかしたら、クラスの誰からかもと、思うこともあるんですね
dialogue.content: So you sometimes think it might be someone from your class.

dialogue.origin: はい・・・怖くてもう誰も信じられません
dialogue.content: Yes… I’m so scared I can’t trust anyone anymore.

dialogue.origin: そのことについては、ネット友達とは相談できたりないですか
dialogue.content: Have you been able to talk with your online friends about this?

dialogue.origin: そこまで話せる相手はいません
dialogue.content: There's no one I can talk to on that level.

dialogue.origin: 誰も信じられなくなってしまったんですね。
dialogue.content: So you've reached a point where you can't trust anyone.

dialogue.origin: それは、本当にお辛いと思います
dialogue.content: That must be truly painful.

dialogue.origin: はい。クラスでも何か言われてるかもしれない…
dialogue.content: Yes. And I feel like people might be saying things about me in class, too...

dialogue.origin: クラスで言われていると思うと怖いですよね
dialogue.content: It must be frightening to think that people are talking about you in class.

dialogue.origin: はい。どうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.content: Yes. What should I do?

dialogue.origin: 誰にも話せないのにお話ししてくれてありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing this with me, especially when you feel you can't talk to anyone.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。どうしていいか今は凄く悩んでよね
dialogue.content: I understand. You're really struggling right now with what to do.

dialogue.origin: 怖いです
dialogue.content: I’m scared.

dialogue.origin: 怖いですよね
dialogue.content: It is scary, isn't it.

dialogue.origin: 学校に行くのは怖いと思いますが保健室登校とかは考えていないですか？
dialogue.content: I imagine going to school feels scary, but have you considered attending by spending time in the school nurse’s office?

dialogue.origin: 考えてみたことがありませんでした
dialogue.content: I'd never thought of that.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね
dialogue.content: I see, you hadn't.

dialogue.origin: いきなり教室はいきにくいと思いますし
dialogue.content: I imagine going straight to the classroom would be difficult.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 話しやすい先生と話して保健室登校も少し考えてみるのはどうでしょうか❔
dialogue.content: How about talking to a teacher you find easy to approach and considering attending from the nurse's office for a while?

dialogue.origin: 話やすい先生が思いあたりません
dialogue.content: I can't think of any teacher I feel comfortable talking to.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: ネット友達には相談も難しいですもんね
dialogue.content: And it's difficult to consult with your online friends, too, right?

dialogue.origin: 地域の相談や学校にいる相談員さんがいれば相談してみてもいいと思います
dialogue.content: I think it might be a good idea to try talking to a local youth support service, or a school counselor if one is available.

dialogue.origin: 地域の相談って何ですか？
dialogue.content: What's a local support service?

dialogue.origin: 何でも相談できるところが地域によってあると思うので調べるのもいいかなと思います
dialogue.content: Most communities have places where you can talk about anything, so it might be a good idea to look one up.

dialogue.origin: そろそろお時間になってしまいますが、今日は相談してみてどうでしたか❔
dialogue.content: We're almost out of time, but how do you feel after our talk today?

dialogue.origin: ネットの相手はどんな人かわからないと思って、もう話す気持になれないって思いました。
dialogue.content: I realized you never know who you're talking to online, and I just can't bring myself to talk there anymore.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。怖いこともありますからね。これからも気をつけてくださいね。相談ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: That's right. Scary things can happen. Please continue to take care. Thank you for talking with me today.

dialogue.origin: また、少しでも不安な時は気軽に相談してくださいね
dialogue.content: And if you ever feel anxious, even a little, please don't hesitate to reach out.

dialogue.origin: はい。いろいろ考えてくれてありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Okay. Thank you for taking the time to think this through with me.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well.

dialogue.origin: 失礼致します。
dialogue.content: Goodbye for now.

dialogue.origin: (大変よい勉強になりました。ありがとうございました)
dialogue.content: (This was a very good learning experience. Thank you very much.)

dialogue.origin: こちらこそありがとうございました。いい勉強になりました。感謝致します
dialogue.content: Thank you as well. It was a good learning experience for me, too. I appreciate it.

dialogue.origin: ではまた相談の時はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Please reach out again if you need to consult.

topic.sub: 孤立感と学校に行きたくない気持ち
